{{Short description|Russian mathematician (born 1962)}}
{{family name hatnote|Vladimirovich|Zorich|lang=Eastern Slavic}}
[[File:Anton zorich.jpg|thumb|Zorich in 2011]]
'''Anton V. Zorich''' (in [[Russian language|Russian]]: ''Антон Владимирович Зорич''; born 3 September 1962) is a Russian mathematician at the [[Institut de mathématiques de Jussieu – Paris Rive Gauche|Institut de mathématiques de Jussieu]]. He is the son of [[Vladimir A. Zorich]]. He received his Ph.D. from [[Moscow State University]] under the supervision of [[Sergei Novikov (mathematician)|Sergei Novikov]].<ref>[http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=62907 Mathematics Genealogy Project]</ref>

He was an invited speaker at the 2006 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Madrid. The theme was: "Geodesics on flat surfaces".<ref>{{Cite book<!-- Deny Citation Bot--> |arxiv = math/0609399 |bibcode=2006math......9399Z |last1 = Zorich|first1 = Anton|title = Geodesics on Flat Surfaces|journal = Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians |volume=3 |publisher=European Mathematical Society |location=Zürich |pages = 121–146 |year = 2006}}</ref>

At least two of his papers concern the explanation of mathematical discoveries he made by experimenting with computers.<ref name="ArnoldKozlov2007">{{cite book|author1=Vladimir I. Arnold|author2=Valery V. Kozlov|author3=Anatoly I. Neishtadt|title=Mathematical Aspects of Classical and Celestial Mechanics|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=25iQQvHe9awC&pg=PA398|date=5 July 2007|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-3-540-48926-9|pages=398}}</ref><ref name="HassettMcKernan2013">{{cite book|author1=[[Brendan Hassett]]|author2=[[James McKernan]]|author3=Jason Starr|author4=[[Ravi Vakil]]|title=A Celebration of Algebraic Geometry|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4UDeAAAAQBAJ&pg=PA149|date=11 September 2013|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|isbn=978-0-8218-8983-1|pages=149}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* with [[Maxim Kontsevich|M. Kontsevich]]: "Connected components of the moduli spaces of Abelian differentials with prescribed singularities", ''[[Inventiones mathematicae]]'' (2003)
* "Flat surfaces", ''Frontiers in number theory, physics, and geometry'' (2006)
* with M. Kontsevich: "Lyapunov exponents and Hodge theory", (1997)
* "Finite Gauss measure on the space of interval exchange transformations. Lyapunov exponents", ''Annales de l'Institut Fourier'' (2003)
* with [[Alex Eskin|A. Eskin]], and [[Howard Masur|H. Masur]]: "Moduli spaces of Abelian differentials: the principal boundary, counting problems, and the Siegel–Veech constants", ''[[Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS|Publications Mathématiques de l'Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques]]'' (2003)
* "Deviation for interval exchange transformations", ''[[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]]'' (1997)
* "How do the leaves of a closed 1-form wind around a surface?", ''Pseudoperiodic topology'' (1999)
